headline: Three vehicle damage claims, including $1,349.08 for a tire and two pothole claims, plus a pending lawsuit.
summary: Residents can give public input before the meeting. A portion of the meeting may be held in executive session on pending litigation.
items: Public input period; sign in or join by Zoom 10 minutes before the meeting
Vehicle claim from Pericles Vieira for $1,349.08 (tire)
Vehicle claim from Napoleon Gonsalves for $275.00 (pothole)
Vehicle claim from Nicholas Jensen for $315.98 (pothole)
Communication from City Solicitor Frank J. Milos, Jr., on pending litigation
Executive session on Wayne Lema v. City of Pawtucket (C.A. No.: PC-2022-06919)

The Pawtucket City Council accepts email testimony for Public Input Period/Public Hearings at 
cityclerk@pawtucketri.gov until 4:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting.   
Please type COUNCIL INPUT in the Subject box. 
 
The public may also participate at Public Input Period/Public Hearings via videoconference:  
Must join 10 minutes prior to meeting.

AGENDA 
 
TO:  All Members of the Committee on Claims and Pending Suits 
Frank J. Milos, Jr., Esq., City Solicitor

Claimants 
 
FROM: Richard J. Goldstein, MMC, City Clerk 
 
DATE: November 5, 2026 
 
SUBJECT: COMMITTEE ON CLAIMS AND PENDING SUITS MEETING 
 
________________________________ 
 
You are requested to attend a meeting of the City Council Committee on Claims and Pending Suits, to 
be held on  Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 6:10 p.m., at the Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 
Freight Street, First Floor – City Council Conference Room - Room 140, Pawtucket, Rhode Island. 
 
The purpose of this meeting is for discussion and/or consideration of the following: 
 
1. PUBLIC INPUT PERIOD Must Sign-in or Join via Zoom 10 minutes prior to meeting 
 
2. VEHICLE CLAIMS: 
 
Pericles Vieira – $1,349.08 (Tire) 
 
Napoleon Gonsalves – $275.00 (Pothole) 
 
Nicholas Jensen – $315.98 (Pothole) 
 
 
3. Communication from Frank J. Milos, Jr., Esq., City Solicitor, to Richard J. Goldstein, MMC, City 
Clerk, (City Council’s Committee on Claims and Pending Suits Meeting of November 10, 2026) 
 
A portion of this meeting may be held in Executive Session pursuant to § 42-46-4 and § 42-46-5 (A)(2) 
of the General Laws of the State of Rhode Island regarding pending litigation. 
 
4. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
 
Wayne Lema v. City of Pawtucket (C.A. No.: PC-2022-06919) 
 
This meeting is being called by Councilor Yesenia Rubio , Chair of the Committee on Claims and 
Pending Suits.
